title: The Concept of Social Capital
text:
Social capital refers to the value derived from social networks and relationships within a community. It encompasses the types of connections, shared trust, and norms that facilitate collective action and economic development.

Key components include bonding social capital (ties between homogenous groups) and bridging social capital (connections between diverse groups). High levels of both are generally associated with stronger institutional resilience and greater overall societal well-being, as they improve information flow and resource mobilization.
